Good afternoon, welcome to VoiceoverGuy.co.uk!

Eze Group Explainer Voice

Another job as Eze Group Explainer Voice. I've talked about it many times but I do seem to have found my niche in this market. Explainer Videos are big business and also, important to websites. Whilst the viewer is happy to read content on a page, they are happier to watch compelling content instead. Short 1 - 2 minute videos are much easier to consume and quite frankly more interesting.

Check out the video

Take this one. Working with Spark Media, the animation is spot on and done well, the music has been carefully chosen to match the product and compliments my voice track.

Eze Group Explainer Voice

Who are the Eze Group?

Welcome to EZE Group – and your passport to an exciting world of travel, leisure and lifestyle opportunities. We offer a whole new approach to planning your leisure time that makes it easy to enjoy countless activities and destinations – as well as huge savings on a vast range of products and services.

Get in touch

If you've got an explainer video or a webvideo and you need a voice for it, maybe like this Eze Group Explainer Voice, then put it in the hands of my 16 years experience. To make the process even easier, just let me know the intended usage of the production and I can quote you more accurately too. Feel free to send a short sample of the script and I'd be more than happy to send you a short audition to check if my voice is right for your show or project.
